metadata.description: Kyle Chalmers' Claude Code plugins for disciplined data work: ticket-driven analysis, orchestration-job governance, Streamlit-in-Snowflake apps, and data+AI security auditing.

plugins.name: ticketwright
plugins.description: Ticket-driven data work with one front door: /ticket opens, primes, and routes; /review QC-gates; /ship hard-halts before external posts. Prior-art recall + self-maintaining catalog, stdlib-only.

plugins.name: jobwright
plugins.description: Govern, validate, and safely ship data-orchestration jobs (Databricks, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake Tasks): jobs catalog, architecture-compliance scanning, live-vs-repo drift detection, and a deploy-safety guard.

plugins.name: streamsnow
plugins.description: Build, govern, and ship Streamlit-in-Snowflake apps: scaffolding, data-governance guardrails, local preview, validation, parallel review, and a gated deploy path.

plugins.name: ai-data-security
plugins.description: Data + AI security auditing: secrets exposure matrix, AI tool config audit, four-tier data classification, and AI-principal database access audit — deterministic script verdicts, read-only, cited findings.
